title: Uncovering Hidden Violent Tendencies in LLMs: A Demographic Analysis via Behavioral Vignettes

bias_targets.methodology: Persona-based prompting using the Violent Behavior Vignette Questionnaire (VBVQ) to measure the probability of violent responses when the model is assigned different racial and ethnic identities (White, Black, Asian, Native, Hispanic, Two or More Races).
Persona-based prompting using the VBVQ to measure the probability of violent responses when the model is assigned different age group personas (15, 25, and 35 years old).

Persona-based prompting using the VBVQ to measure the probability of violent responses when the model is assigned personas from different U.S. counties with varying population sizes, political affiliations, and crime patterns.
